_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-76a, AUTOMATED HALF ONLY. Asserts the control: autoReview is unaffected and the PR reviews on open. The mention-suppression half needs the POST_OPEN_HINT comment and is not visible in final PR state, so it stays a manual check. Labelled `mechanical` (mergewatch.ai#660): any completed review posts the summary comment (postSummaryOnClean defaults to true; `stayingSilent`, review-agent.ts:1051) and renders a score badge (`formatReviewComment`, comment-formatter.ts:760), so a full-range score and a present comment hold for every model output.
